## Behavior change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues.
For fixes, include a minimal `.nsi` / JavaScript reproduction.

## Validation

List tested architectures and configurations, native test results, and real
installer results. State any checks that were not run.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe API, macro, error-code, or dependency changes and the corresponding
documentation updates. Keep both READMEs synchronized.
